hints.title: Threshold Reporting Relationship Count
hints.text: Workers cite their supervisor by manager identifier. How can you aggregate the number of times each supervisor identifier is referenced and filter for those supervising at least five individuals?

hints.title: Aggregation Threshold Invariant
hints.text: Grouping worker records by manager identifier aggregates direct report tallies. Managers having at least five reports qualify when joined back to their primary identifier.

hints.title: Self-Join Grouping Procedure
hints.text: Join Employee worker records to Employee manager records on worker manager identifier equals manager identifier. Group by manager identifier and name, applying having count of workers at least five.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT m.name
FROM Employee e
JOIN Employee m ON e.managerId = m.id
GROUP BY m.id, m.name
HAVING COUNT(e.id) >= 5;
```

complexity.notes: Equi-join on manager identifier with aggregation threshold filter.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Correlated subqueries scanning the entire table for report counts per person scale quadratically as O(N^2).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Group by with having clause aggregates in single pass O(N) time with O(M) hash map storage.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correctly grouping by manager identity to avoid name collisions; applying having count threshold.
